subject: Hosting options and data-jurisdiction sprint plan — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliabank.com>, Mikael Sørensen <mikael.sorensen@aureliabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 14:07:00 -0400
Subject: Quick recap & open questions from today's call — hosting and region constraints

Hi Elena / Mikael,

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and the few open questions we promised to follow up on.

Key notes from the call:
- Primary requirement: EU-only data residency for all EU customers (at-rest and processing).
- Expansion: Aurelia expects to start APAC pilots H2; APAC customers may impose stricter in-region processing later.
- Traffic pattern: ~85% EU requests today, low bursty traffic from APAC.
- Security/compliance: you requested SOC 2 evidence + clarification on KMS and audit logs.

Open questions for your confirmation:
1) Is EU residency a hard requirement for ALL data (logs, telemetry, cached keys), or only customer PII?
2) Will cross-region inference calls be allowed if we guarantee no persistence outside EU (e.g., proxying APAC calls through EU region temporarily)?
3) Expected steady-state RPS and peak tokens per minute so we can size a dedicated pool if needed.

Recommended short-list of deployment paths (high level):
A) Hosted API scoped to EU region (fastest onboarding) — we can lock your tenant to EU-hosting, provide DPA language and SOC 2 summary. Good if you don’t need private networking.
B) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) — tenant isolation + predictable throughput; still hosted in your selected region (EU).
C) Private VPC / on-prem — for the strictest isolation and network controls; longer lead time and procurement.

I attached a one‑page checklist to capture the residency specifics and a lightweight schedule template for the rollout.

Next steps I propose:
- Elena/Mikael: confirm answers to the three open questions above by EOD Monday (May 17).
- If EU residency is hard: we’ll loop in LAURA (security) and VIVEK (solutions) for a short technical note on what Hosted EU-lock vs Dedicated/VPC entail.
- I can put together a POC plan for Hosted EU-only (2 week tech spike) if you want to validate latency and data flow.

Attachments: Aurelia-data-residency-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliabank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mikael Sørensen <mikael.sorensen@aureliabank.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick recap & open questions from today's call — hosting and region constraints

Hi Ben,

Thanks — helpful summary. Answers inline below.

1) EU residency scope: this is a hard requirement for EU-resident customers. That includes customer PII, model inputs/outputs derived from EU users, and any logs that could be used to reconstruct requests. Operational telemetry that is strictly aggregated and anonymized is OK to leave global, but request/response data must remain in the EU.

2) Cross-region inference: we cannot accept routing EU customer data outside the EU perimeter. APAC calls from APAC customers are separate and can be routed to APAC if available. For the immediate term, APAC traffic will be small — we are willing to proxy APAC traffic to EU for a limited pilot only if there is contractual assurance that no persistence or logs will leave the EU.

3) Traffic: current production expectations are modest — ~200 RPS steady, peaks to ~2k RPS during batch runs. Token volumes roughly 1.2M tokens/day initially. We will confirm with infra team for precise numbers.

Compliance evidence: please send SOC 2 summary and the list of available certifications and encryption options (customer-managed KMS?). Also send a diagram of data flows for Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC deployment.

If Hosted EU-only can truly guarantee no persistence or caching outside the EU and offers a customer KMS option, that would be our preferred fast path. If not, we will need to evaluate Dedicated or VPC.

Best,
Elena
Head of Data Privacy — Aurelia Bank
elena.rossi@aureliabank.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap & open questions from today's call — hosting and region constraints

Laura / Vivek — looping you both in on Aurelia's replies (below). Key asks:
- EU residency is HARD for EU customers (PII, requests/response, logs that could be reconstructed).
- They may proxy APAC to EU short term only under strong contractual guarantees.
- Preliminary traffic: ~200 RPS steady; peaks to ~2k RPS.

Action items I need from you:
- Laura: can you confirm whether Hosted API can be offered with a firm EU-only processing and storage guarantee (including KV/prefix cache behavior)? Also, what evidence (SOC 2 summary + data flow diagram) can we share quickly?
- Vivek: from a product/infra standpoint, what are the differences we should highlight between: Hosted EU-tenant locked + customer-managed KMS, Dedicated capacity in EU, and Private VPC? Please call out: time-to-setup, isolation guarantees, audit log availability, and network egress controls.

Elena wants a short diagram and SOC 2 summary. I attached their checklist for capture and will send our SOC 2 summary + one-pager once we have your inputs.

Ben

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Recommended path & proposed next steps for Aurelia (Hosted EU-lock → Dedicated/VPC runway)

Hi Elena / Mikael,

Appreciate the clarity — based on your constraints, below is a recommended phased approach and concrete next steps so we can move quickly without blocking your roadmap.

Short-term (fastest, 2 week tech spike): Hosted API — EU-locked tenant
- What we deliver: Tenant configured so all inference requests and cached KV/prefix data are stored and processed in our EU region. No persistence outside EU for request/response data.
- Controls: optional customer-managed KMS for model keys/audit logs, enhanced retention configuration (we can set zero-persistence for request bodies if required), SOC 2 summary and data-flow diagram attached.
- Good fit: when you want fastest time-to-value and do not need network-level VPC peering.

Medium-term (if isolation or predictable throughput required, 6–8 weeks): Dedicated capacity in EU
- What we deliver: reserved GPU pool with tenant isolation, capacity commitments, and per-tenant audit logs. You retain EU residency guarantees. We can offer stricter caching policies and dedicated KV stores.
- Good fit: when you need consistent latency under peak or want contractual throughput guarantees.

Long-term (strictest, 10–12+ weeks): Private VPC / on-prem option
- What we deliver: VPC peering or on-prem package — full network isolation, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and the tightest control for audits and regulatory reviews.
- Good fit: highly regulated lines of business or when procurement requires on-prem solutions.

Evidence & artifacts attached: SOC2-summary.pdf, deployment-options-onepager.pdf (data-flow diagrams + feature matrix).

Concrete next steps / owners:
- Aurelia: confirm whether EU residency applies to logs + request bodies (Elena) — target: EOD Wed May 19.
- Redwood: provide a short technical note (1 page) confirming "EU-only processing and no persistence outside EU" + KMS options (Laura) — target: Tue May 18.
- Redwood: produce a Dedicated vs Hosted comparison with estimated setup timelines and cost ballpark (Vivek) — target: Thu May 20.
- Schedule: I propose a 30-min technical sync (Ben, Vivek, Laura, Aurelia infra) next week to align on the POC scope. Please share availability here: https://cal.com/ben-carter/30 (or propose times).

If that plan looks good, I’ll draft a short SOW for the Hosted EU POC (2 weeks) and include the minimal acceptance criteria we discussed.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference
